description.value: You might have been programmed to narrate a nature documentary while swimming with sea life, or you might resemble an anthropomorphic electrovore created to sing educational songs to children. Regardless of your appearance and original purpose, the collective love and respect you received over the years coalesced into a soul. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Additional Lore] skill feat and the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Assurance] skill feat for the chosen Lore.
